title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager - Health

Market Drayton

Monday - Friday

Müller is growing its presence within health and nutrition, creating new opportunities to reach consumers and expand into developing areas of the market.

We're looking for a Brand Manager - Health to join our award-winning Marketing Team and help shape the next stage of that growth. You'll have the opportunity to work across brand strategy, innovation and activation, helping create new products and bring compelling campaigns to life.

This is a varied Brand Manager role covering the full marketing mix, including innovation, communications, digital, PR, packaging, shopper marketing and in-store activation. You'll work on some of the nation's most recognised dairy brands, alongside newer partnerships and propositions such as Müller x Myprotein.

Your challenge

You'll take responsibility for areas of the Müller health portfolio, helping develop the brand plans and innovation needed to unlock further growth.

Depending on your background, your strengths may sit within brand development and strategy, or you may have broader experience launching products and delivering effective activation. What matters is your ability to understand consumers, make commercially grounded recommendations and turn plans into results.

You'll work closely with Sales, Category, Commercial, R&D and agency partners, bringing different teams together to develop products, secure distribution and deliver impactful campaigns.

Key responsibilities
- Support the development and delivery of brand strategies and annual brand plans.
- Lead new product development from initial idea through to launch and in-market activation.
- Plan and execute activity across media, communications, shopper and commercial channels.
- Act as a key day-to-day contact for creative and media agencies, with support from the Senior Brand Manager.
- Take responsibility for areas of the health portfolio, including brand planning, innovation development and commercial performance.
- Work with Sales and Category teams to understand performance and identify distribution and growth opportunities.
- Use brand, consumer and commercial data to make clear recommendations.
- Track brand and campaign performance against agreed measures and identify where activity needs to be adjusted.
- Coordinate cross-functional project teams and manage multiple priorities.
- Manage and develop one direct report.

About you

You'll have consumer marketing experience, ideally gained in FMCG, food, drink, nutrition, health and wellness or another fast-paced branded environment.

We're looking for someone who can bring a combination of:
- Brand strategy and practical in-market execution.
- New product development or innovation experience.
- Campaign, media, communications or brand activation experience.
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing decisions affect wider business performance.
- Confidence using data and insight to inform brand recommendations.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- The ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams.
- A collaborative, pragmatic approach and the confidence to take ownership.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. You might be particularly strong in brand positioning and innovation, or you might have deeper experience in activation, communications and driving brand growth in market.

Benefits:
- Annual bonus of up to 10%
- Annual pay reviews
- Private healthcare cover
- 4 x life assurance
- Pension plan - up to 8% matched contribution
- 25 days annual leave - increasing with service - plus bank holidays
- Purchase/sell annual leave scheme
- Enhanced maternity/paternity/family leave policy
- Employee assistance programme
- In addition, our employees have access to a Rewards Benefits Programme, giving you a range of discounts across 800 retailers online and in store

If you're ready to take real ownership, work across the full marketing mix and help develop Müller's growing health portfolio, we'd like to hear from you.

You can find out more about Müller and what it's like to work for us by clicking here Careers at Müller UK & Ireland

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Based in the heart of Shropshire, our established and growing organisation delivers high-quality services and products to clients across the UK. We take pride in building lasting relationships, fostering a collaborative culture, and continuously refining how we engage with our audience. As our business continues to expand its reach, strengthening our brand presence and communicating our values through modern digital channels has never been more vital.

The Digital Marketing Executive role is pivotal to our commercial ambition. By taking ownership of our day-to-day digital activities, you will directly influence how prospects discover us, how customers interact with our services, and how our reputation flourishes online. You will work closely with colleagues across sales, operations, and creative teams to ensure our messaging is consistent, compelling, and aligned with our strategic goals.

Based in Shropshire, you will enjoy working in one of the country's most picturesque market towns, offering a vibrant independent food scene, historic architecture, and beautiful countryside right on your doorstep, making Shropshire an exceptional place to live and work.

Location: Shropshire

Salary: £29,000 - £32,500 per year

Employment: Permanent

The Role

As our Digital Marketing Executive, you will plan, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns that drive engagement, generate qualified leads, and raise brand awareness.
- Planning and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across organic social media, email, and digital advertising.
- Managing our day-to-day social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X, engaging proactively with our online community.
- Writing clear, persuasive, and search-optimised copy for our website, blog posts, case studies, and digital newsletters.
- Designing, building, and deploying targeted email marketing campaigns, including automated workflows, customer segmentation, and A/B testing.
- Overseeing on-page SEO activities, identifying keyword opportunities, and coordinating technical updates with external web developers.
- Monitoring, managing, and optimising paid search and paid social campaigns to maximise return on ad spend.
- Tracking website traffic, user journeys, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4, translating raw data into actionable commercial insights.
- Collaborating with internal teams to produce high-quality multimedia assets, including graphics, short-form video, and digital brochures.
- Conducting regular competitor analysis and industry benchmarking to keep our digital strategies fresh, relevant, and effective.

About You
- Proven experience in a digital marketing role, with demonstrable success in managing digital campaigns from concept to completion (essential).
- Exceptional written communication skills, with an eye for detail, accurate proofreading ability, and the flexibility to adapt tone for different audiences (essential).
- Practical familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and core digital reporting frameworks (essential).
- Hands-on experience working with email marketing platforms, automation tools, and content management systems such as WordPress (essential).
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, prioritise workloads, and remain calm under pressure (essential).
- Experience with digital design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva for producing visual assets (desirable).
- Working knowledge of PPC advertising, including Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager (desirable).
- A relevant degree or professional qualification in marketing, communications, or a related discipline (desirable).

A Typical Day

Your morning might begin with a review of key campaign analytics from the previous day, checking engagement metrics and tweaking active paid social adverts to improve performance. Mid-morning could see you drafting an insightful article for the company blog and scheduling accompanying social media posts, followed by a collaborative catch-up with the sales team to coordinate content for an upcoming campaign. After lunch, you might design an automated email workflow for new subscribers, review technical SEO recommendations, and spend an hour testing new graphic templates for an upcoming digital newsletter before planning your priorities for the rest of the week.

What You Can Expect
- A permanent role with a growing, ambitious Shropshire organisation dedicated to delivering excellence.
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- A structured training programme and genuine support to help you develop your career towards a marketing manager position.
- A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative working environment where your ideas and initiative are welcomed.
- Modern office facilities in Shropshire with complimentary refreshments and on-site parking.
- Access to a workplace pension scheme and regular team social events throughout the year.
- Dedicated personal development time to attend marketing webinars, workshops, and industry conferences.

If you are an ambitious marketer ready to take the next step in your career and make a tangible contribution to our continued growth, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your CV alongside a tailored cover letter explaining why your experience and skills align with this position.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Our client is an established professional services business in Shrewsbury and they are looking for a Marketing Manager to deliver all marketing activities across the organisation. The role works closely with the Director responsible for marketing supporting the development of the overall marketing plan.

The Marketing Manager is responsible for managing the CRM system, co-ordinating internal communications and departmental marketing plans, organising events as well as maintaining social media and website content.

Duties
- Maintaining accurate and reliable client and prospect data
- Creating and managing marketing campaigns
- Supporting the development and implementation of marketing plans across departments
- Working with department heads to identify marketing opportunities and objectives for their clients
- Reviewing client survey feedback, sharing findings and co-ordinating follow up actions to support awareness and lead generation

Experience
- Experienced in a marketing or communications role
- Experienced in using Marketing Design Tools (eg Adobe Suite, Canva)
- Experienced in using CRM systems
- Experienced in managing social media platforms and website content
- Strong organisation and project co-ordination skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A marketing qualification or relevant professional certification (desirable)
- Experienced in using email marketing platforms (desirable)
- Knowledge of SEO and website analytics tools (desirable)
- Experienced in co-ordinating corporate events (desirable)
- A full driving licence and own vehicle is essential

title: Product & Brand Executive
description:
Are you the kind of person who spots a blurry product photo from across the room? Do you love making a range look great, priced right and selling well? Join Berwick Care and own our product range from screen to shelf.

We supply care and healthcare products to customers across the UK. We're looking for a Product & Brand Executive to take charge of our 4,000-product website, grow our own-brand range and drive sales through smart pricing and promotions.

What you'll do
- Keep our 4,000 website products accurate and appealing - images, descriptions, categories and related products
- Set up new products and recommend what to add or drop from the range
- Shape our own-brand look, designing it yourself or working with our branding agency
- Keep our prices competitive as the market changes
- Come up with promotions and create the flyers, banners and emails that support them

Requirements

Essential
- 2+ years in a product, e-commerce, range or brand role
- Managing large product catalogues on a website / CMS
- Commercial awareness of pricing and margin
- Eligible to work in the United Kingdom

Desirable
- Care, healthcare or medical supplies experience
- Confident with Excel for pricing and product data
- Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP
- Adobe Creative Suite or Canva design skills
- Briefing and managing creative agencies
- SEO knowledge
- Running and measuring promotions

Benefits
- Annual salary: 30,000 GBP/year
- Free breakfast, lunch and snacks, plus full cooking facilities
- Full commercial-spec gym on site
- Free on-site parking
- 24 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Profit-share bonus scheme
- Career development and external training
- Employee Assistance Programme (mental health and financial wellbeing)
- Friendly, supportive team with team lunches, bake-offs and social events
